title: Standardised AI use cases
description: Reference definitions of the standardised AI use cases UC1 to UC10, on the authority (A), boundary (B) and confidentiality channel (K) scales. Each item validates against schemas/use-case.schema.json.

items.title: Staff copilot drafts and summarises
items.description: An AI assistant drafts, summarises or searches for staff, who remain the authors of what is sent or decided.
examples: Drafting emails or reports with a general-purpose assistant
Summarising a file of documents for a case officer
exclusions: A copilot whose draft is sent without review is UC3 or UC8

items.title: Score or recommendation shown to a decision-maker
items.description: AI produces a score, ranking or recommendation that a person sees and decides on.
examples: Credit risk score shown to a lending officer
Fraud alert reviewed by an analyst
exclusions: If the score decides the case without a person, UC3

items.title: Automated triage or decline
items.description: AI decides how a case, claim or application is routed, or declines it, without a person deciding each case.
examples: Automatic decline of a credit application
Claims triage that fast-tracks or refers claims

items.title: Automated pricing or straight-through payment
items.description: AI sets a price or executes a payment or transaction straight through.

items.title: Agent acting across steps and tools
items.description: An AI agent plans and carries out a task across several steps, calling tools or other systems.
examples: An agent that gathers documents, checks them and prepares a file
exclusions: An agent that writes to systems of record is UC6

items.title: Agent with write access to systems of record
items.description: An AI agent that can create, change or delete entries in systems of record.
examples: An agent that updates customer records or posts ledger entries

items.title: AI inside a provider or the platform behind it
items.description: AI used by a service provider, or by the platform the provider relies on, in delivering a service to the organization.
examples: A provider's claims platform that uses AI
A cloud platform's AI features inside an outsourced service

items.title: Customer-facing assistant
items.description: An AI assistant that customers or members talk to directly.

items.title: AI-generated code in production systems
items.description: Code written or changed with AI assistance that runs in production systems.
examples: Coding assistant output merged into a core banking service

items.title: AI tools reachable by a deal team
items.description: AI tools that people working on a confidential transaction can reach, through which deal information could be exposed.
examples: A general-purpose assistant used to summarise a data room
